title: Ad-hoc dependency tally — sprint zero
summary: Quick, lightweight tracker capturing one-off dependency ownership and temporary mitigation steps for sprint-zero launch gates. Purpose is to have a single row-per-dependency that SRE/infra, product, and solutions can scan during standups and oncall handoffs.
tracker_rows: 1 | API Gateway (edge-router) | Diego Alvarez | Priya Singh | throttling enabled on specific paths (experimental) | high (external traffic) | temporary rate-limit relaxation for low-risk paths; enableburst to 2x | 2h | waiting on quota change in cloud provider | make public-facing doc for allowed paths

2 | Routing policy service (smart-routing) | Priya Singh | Maya Chen | degraded: route collisions during cold-starts | medium (latency spikes) | pin critical customers to pinned-region rule; fallback to simple round-robin | 6h | model variant compatibility check pending | collecting sample traces

3 | KV cache cluster (redis-readonly) | Lena Kovács | Diego Alvarez | saturation on write bursts | high (token generation latency) | increase maxclients; reduce TTL for noncritical prefixes | 4h | permissions change requires infra approval | coordinate with infra on ops window

4 | Model-bundle-store (artifact service) | Priya Singh | Rahul Mehta | intermittent 503s for large bundles | medium (deploy delays) | serve smaller quantized bundles from replica; deny large bulk uploads temporarily | 8h | storage GC running longer than expected | follow up with release-engineering

5 | Regional edge (eu-west) | Ola Nwankwo | Maya Chen | partial telemetry loss | low (affects observability only) | route a percentage of traffic to eu-central; enable verbose request-ids | 1h | missing cert rotation for edge proxy | ops to rotate certs after cutoff

6 | Telemetry aggregation pipeline | Lena Kovács | Priya Singh | backlog growth ~2x | medium (alerts delayed) | temporarily drop low-priority metrics; bump pipeline workers | 3h | IAM token expiry scheduled | apply service-account refresh patch

7 | Billing meter (usage-collector) | Rahul Mehta | Diego Alvarez | delayed invoice calculation | low (internal only) | run manual reconcile job for affected accounts | 24h | dependent on daily export completeness | notify finance of possible delays

8 | Fallback-model-set (quantized-8bit) | Maya Chen | Priya Singh | capacity limits when falling back | high (customer-facing regressions) | pre-warm a small pool of quantized replicas; enable canary distribution | 6h | model-loading memory spike observed | SRE to attach heap/dump on next occurrence
next_steps: 1) Owners to ack rows before next standup (by EOD). 2) SRE to apply KV cache short-term config and report latency delta. 3) Product to confirm pinned-customer list and post to Confluence. 4) Infra to schedule cert rotation window and update this sheet. 5) Solutions engineering to pre-warm fallback-model-set for top-3 customers.
notes: This is intentionally 'light-touch'—use this as a rapid source-of-truth during the sprint. If a dependency needs longer-lived tracking, create a follow-up tracker under product-ops and link it in linked_artifacts. Rows reflect current observations; fill status column as you take actions.
